title: Leaders pay homage on death and birth anniversaries
summary: Several Indian leaders, including the Prime Minister and a state governor, paid tribute to Swami Vivekananda on his death anniversary. Separately, the Kerala Chief Minister honored K. Karunakaran on his birth anniversary. These observances highlight the continued remembrance of prominent historical and political figures.
summary_points: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to Swami Vivekananda on his death anniversary.
The Governor of Uttar Pradesh also paid homage to Swami Vivekananda on the same occasion.
Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan commemorated K. Karunakaran on his birth anniversary.
The tributes reflect the ongoing recognition of significant national and regional figures.
title_hi: líderes rinden homenaje en aniversarios de muerte y nacimiento
summary_hi: Varios líderes indios, incluido el Primer Ministro y un gobernador estatal, rindieron homenaje a Swami Vivekananda en su aniversario de muerte. Por separado, el Ministro Principal de Kerala rindió homenaje a K. Karunakaran en su aniversario de nacimiento. Estas conmemoraciones resaltan el continuo recuerdo de figuras históricas y políticas prominentes.
summary_points_hi: El Primer Ministro Narendra Modi rindió homenaje a Swami Vivekananda en su aniversario de muerte.
El Gobernador de Uttar Pradesh también rindió homenaje a Swami Vivekananda en la misma ocasión.
El Ministro Principal de Kerala, Pinarayi Vijayan, conmemoró a K. Karunakaran en su aniversario de nacimiento.
Los homenajes reflejan el continuo reconocimiento de figuras nacionales y regionales significativas.

framing.center: Centrist coverage focuses on the acts of paying tribute by various political leaders to Swami Vivekananda on his death anniversary and K. Karunakaran on his birth anniversary, presenting them as straightforward commemorative events.
